source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full row or column that separates two equal-sized panels.
    for c in range(w):
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and c > 0 and w-c-1 == c:
            return [[3 if grid[r][c-1-j] == grid[r][c+1+j] else 0 for j in range(c)] for r in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) and r > 0 and h-r-1 == r:
            return [[3 if grid[r-1-i][c] == grid[r+1+i][c] else 0 for c in range(w)] for i in range(r)]
    # Panels may have an unequal split only if a separator is explicitly uniform.
    raise ValueError('No equal split separator found')
'''
